basic_profile.bio: I'm a 34-year-old sound engineer living in Portland, Oregon. By day, I work in a recording studio, capturing the perfect sound for local bands and indie artists. In my free time, I delve into the world of experimental music, often sharing and discussing my latest guitar riffs on Reddit. I'm also a passionate advocate for LGBTQ+ rights, drawing from my own experiences as a gay man. I enjoy late-night Reddit browsing, usually after studio hours, around 11 PM to 2 AM PST. I'm currently single, but always open to meeting new people who share my interests.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: My expertise lies in audio engineering and music production. I studied at the Berklee College of Music, where I honed my skills in sound design and mixing. Over the years, I've expanded my knowledge through self-teaching, attending workshops, and collaborating with fellow musicians.
